summary: Horizon Stage 2 closeout final regression. All 7 fixes verified, and the full 1080p and 4K regression passed with no console errors. Backend: 174/174 unit tests pass. Live suite: 30/30 via the preview URL, including the new tests_live/test_runtime_unreachable_live.py, which reproduces the 'unknown' runtime status live. Verified fixes: (1) Detail primary-action focus ring shows on first load and after mouse input on /movies/2 and /shows/3, at 1920x1080 and 3840 wide. (2) Unreadable files report 'unknown': in a 150-episode TEST_ library, 5 files deleted right after the scan all became 'unknown' and /api/metadata/status showed unreachable=5; after the files were restored and rescanned they went to pending, then known. (3) Remaining-time wording matches: the Home stage chip and the movie detail both say '36 s left'. (4) Episode fallback art: episode-art-fallback-6 is empty and aria-hidden, so the code shows once. (5) Down from the next-up action goes to the selected season tab, both without progress (season-tab-1) and with S02E01 progress (season-tab-2); this also works from the Start episode over button. (6) Right on the last season tab stays there (edge stop) and Left/Right switch tabs. (7) Clicking Player Next with the mouse moves /play/10 to /play/11 with mode=osd; keyboard Right then seeks +10 s, Enter pauses/resumes, Up expands, Esc goes to hidden and a second Esc exits. Regression at 1920x1080: Home stage/details/filmstrip navigation and focus restore (stage-details-action and film-card-movie-2); movie Resume 0:54; player OSD hides after about 4 s while playing and stays while paused; Left -10 s; Up expands with focus on play/pause; Right in expanded moves focus only; Esc collapses, then exits with focus restored to movie-resume-button; Episode Journey Left/Right/Up/Down and PageUp/PageDown; reduced motion (transition 0s, navigation still works); simulated gamepad (D-pad, RB/LB, A plays, B goes back with focus restored). 4K: the tool caps the viewport at 3840x1920 (data-ui-scale 1.78), so CDP Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride was used to get 3840x2160, which gives data-ui-scale=2 with no overflow on home, movie, show, /movies, /shows and the player. Seek bar clicks at 25/50/75% landed at 22.77/45.00/67.51 s. Settings scrolls vertically, as expected. Everything was simulated; nothing was tested on a physical Xbox, Windows PC or 4K TV.

minor.issue: Files that could not be reached are counted in both 'pending' (probe_json IS NULL) and 'unreachable'. With 5 files unreachable it returned pending=5 and unreachable=5, while every item showed runtime_status 'unknown'. Consider pending = NULL minus unreachable so the summary matches the per-item status.

action_items: Optional: make the /api/metadata/status 'pending' count exclude unreachable files so it matches the per-item runtime_status
critical_code_review_comments: routes_library._runtime_status and durations.DurationReader.is_unreachable/wake look correct: wake() clears _skipped on every scan, so unreachable files are retried. Only the status summary double-counts them (see minor issue).
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_unreach_<tag> library under /tmp was created and deleted via DELETE /api/libraries/{id}; /tmp dirs removed. Progress created during tests (files 7, 10, 11) was deleted; Sample Movie file 2 was restored to 54.397367/90.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The real routes are /, /movies, /movies/:id, /shows, /shows/:id, /play/:fileId and /settings (the Library nav item). Anything else redirects to Home. Playwright set_viewport_size(3840,2160) is capped to 3840x1920 (scale 1.78), so use a CDP session with Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride {width:3840,height:2160,deviceScaleFactor:1} to get scale 2. The *_4k screenshots were taken at the capped 3840x1920. Run the live suite serially: python -m pytest tests_live -n 0. The new unreachable test hardlinks 150 copies from a /tmp seed copy, because /app to /tmp is cross-device. Playing media writes progress, so delete or restore it afterwards (Sample Movie file 2 = 54.397367/90; Northern Survey files 7-11 = no progress).
